name: default-off native token-profile paged KV owner
source_repository: original mlx2 implementation based on private codex/varlen-paged-attention revision 6127ad4eb975f1a56b6f8b4b33e4c1bca672f61a
license: original mlx2 project code; no third-party implementation copied
modifications: Added a candidate-only token profile and completion-gated private owner. Page-local writes use the immutable reader's [page, KV head, token, channel] byte address, with one validated source chunk per head per page segment. Native source shape checks run before page reservation. No shared-tail copy, adapter conversion, or serving route is added.
validation: CPU MLX-array/fake-backend tests cover 63/64/65-token addresses for two KV heads, source/capacity preflight, out-of-order successful callbacks, failed callback retirement, and shared-tail COW refusal; focused paged cache and write tests also pass.
limitations: The fake backend does not prove native GPU token writes, same-stream diagnostic reads, real command-buffer failure retirement, APCv2 ownership, numerical attention parity, or any model serving route.
